facts.summary: MacBaram requires Apple silicon and macOS 13 or later.
User-defined fan curves and fan control are available when the Mac reports a verified controllable-fan capability.
Charging-related limits are available on supported portable Macs.
Sleep prevention is available for long-running work on supported Macs.
At the user-configured low-battery threshold, MacBaram can release sleep prevention and allow normal macOS sleep behavior.

On supported fan-equipped MacBooks, Heat Protection can coordinate a charging pause and an available fan response from the same battery-temperature condition, then restore the active fan policy after cooling.
Virtual Clamshell is available on supported Apple silicon MacBooks for lid-closed work without a real external monitor, subject to its hardware, power, permission, and workload boundaries.
Air, Desktop, and Pro are the current individual plan families; commercial availability and exact terms remain canonical on the official website.
Enterprise Single is a future single-Mac direction and is not a currently available product plan.
Enterprise Fleet is a future organization-level multi-Mac direction and is not a currently available product plan.
Fan, battery, power, and sleep state are presented in one dashboard.
iMac support is not currently declared; affected controls remain unavailable when required capability is not verified.
